title: David Reich — How one small tribe conquered the world 70,000 years ago
summary: Dwarkesh Patel interviews ancient-DNA geneticist David Reich about human prehistory, including the small group that left Africa around 70,000 years ago and the Yamnaya expansion.
why: Recommended as a nuanced, up-to-date account of human prehistory from a leading researcher in ancient DNA.

quote.text: David Reich is probably the leading researcher in this field and his description of our best guesses is highly nuanced and open to new data.
